## Wave 3 Summary

This wave attacks the framework's single load-bearing open object — the **emergent scale factor `a(t)` / effective-Friedmann bridge** — from four structurally-distinct axes plus one isolating falsifier-test of one of its three logical components. The integration-plan (§E note + §6.3 convergence) flags EIN-V2 + KAK-V3 + transit-V5 + HAW-V4 as ONE multi-axis object: a derived, generally-covariant 4D action for the emergent metric `g_M` (itself the `a₂` Seeley-DeWitt moment of `D_K`) would simultaneously deliver (a) the scale factor `a(t)`, (b) the emergent equivalence principle, and (c) the emergent Einstein–Infeld–Hoffmann theorem (geodesic motion of emergent matter as a *consequence* of the `a₂`-channel field equations, not a postulate). The einstein capstone review (§III.2) established that capstone frontiers #1 (`a(t)`) and #8 (emergent Lorentz/EP) are **logically the same gap**; closing one closes both.

**Substrate-first framing is the controlling discipline of this entire wave** (`.claude/rules/phononic-framing.md`). The a(t)/Friedmann gap is the prime container-thinking trap. Every gate flows `D_K eigenvalues → spectral-action moments (a_n) → emergent field equations → observed physics`, and NEVER invokes a fundamental Friedmann equation. The Friedmann equation, where it appears at all, appears ONLY as the *equation of state of the emergent metric* (Jacobson 1995 reading, hawking §II.4) — a thing to be DERIVED as a consequence of the spectral action, never posited as a fundamental law. The S74 W1-E FAIL (no derived `H²=(8πG/3)ρ`) is STRUCTURAL and correct (`atlas-09-retractions-materials.md` Item 35: the single-`f_conv`-scalar bridge is PROVEN insufficient), not a near-miss to be patched.

**Honest-outcome pre-registration**: four of these five gates are open-frontier *scoping* gates where INFO is a likely and structurally-honest pre-registered outcome — a partial structural result (the *form* of the obstruction, or the *form* of `H²(τ,τ̇)` without its second normalization) is a constraint-map advance, NOT a failure. The INFO band is pre-registered explicitly in each, NOT pre-judged. Only EMERGENT-EP-NLO (§W3-5) is a clean decisive falsifier-test with a sharp PASS/FAIL discriminator (and an honest INFO escape for scheme-ambiguity).

**Carry-forward source**: collab integration-plan §E rows EIN-V2/KAK-V3/transit-V5/HAW-V4/EIN-V1, drawn from the 10-domain `/rclab-review` panel on `sessions/framework/phonic-exflation-equation.md` (commit 5e5d5fa9).

This wave has **no upstream S95 prerequisite** — all five gates consume only S94-and-earlier canonical artifacts (spectral caches, `canonical_constants.py`, closed-form curvature/spectral-action moments) plus the four feeder collab reviews. The one cross-feed is HAW-V4 (HAWKING-CC-HORIZON-FORM, §W3-4) supplying the **de Sitter horizon-energy-density FORM** of C10 — a SPEC for the C10 derivation target, not its closure; the CC 114-OOM gap itself was closed by DILUTION-CC-66 (`rho_vac/rho_obs=1.032`, PASS — NOT re-adjudicated here).

**Mechanical-closure note**: no gate in this wave is expected to require mechanical closure (no prereq-block topology). If any feeder input file is absent at dispatch, the gate honestly closes per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` with a `value='upstream_<reason>'` string — but all cited inputs are static canonical artifacts confirmed present at plan-freeze.

```yaml
substitution_chain:
```

## §W3-2. EFF-FRIEDMANN-GENRE

```yaml
# ---- Identity (4 fields) ----
gate_id: "S95-W3-2-EFF-FRIEDMANN-GENRE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[CHAIN]"

  the M_KK⁻¹→seconds normalization is pinned. The a(t) gap is the GENERIC
  background-independence problem of any one-functional theory (SFT has the same

    τ-gradient is the dynamical content. Step 2: write the emergent Friedmann-form

    ρ_eff = ½ G_DeWitt τ̇² + V_a₂(τ) and 1/(16πG_eff) = f₂Λ²a₂(τ)/(48π²). Step 3:
    test whether this closes to a τ-only ODE H²=F(τ,τ̇) with all symbols pinned
    EXCEPT the Z_fold/seconds normalization — and EXHIBIT the residual free
    normalization explicitly. Step 4: cross-check the GENRE claim — confirm the
    form has NO Hagedorn tower (polynomial DOS, S_d={0,2,4,6,8} closes), NO
    S-duality, NO T-duality self-dual point (E7 monotone, no stationary τ), so
    the emergent-background extraction is matrix-model-class (computable) not
    SFT-class. Substrate arrow held: D_K spectrum → a₂ eigenvalue-functional →
    emergent H²(τ); H is the READOUT of spectral reorganization, never a clock the
    vacuum decays in (§6.3).
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s95_w3_2_eff_friedmann_genre.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

operator:
  type: "equality (closed-form-completeness test)"
  form: >
    closure_flag ≡ (H²(τ,τ̇) reduces to a function of (τ,τ̇) with exactly ONE
    residual free normalization Z_norm). PASS iff closure_flag AND the residual
    free-parameter count = 1 (the seconds normalization only); INFO iff the form

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "residual_free_normalization_count == 1 (seconds-normalization only) AND closed H²(τ,τ̇) form exhibited"
  direction: "="

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    a₂(τ) is a closed analytic function (E3-derived); dS/dτ=58672.8 at fold
    (dS_fold, S42) is the monotone gradient; G_DeWitt=5.0 (S42) is the modulus
    kinetic coefficient; the Chamseddine–Connes dictionary 1/(16πG_N)=f₂Λ²a₂/(48π²)

    structural facts already in the corpus (E7 monotonicity; S_d={0,2,4,6,8}
    closes; kaku §II.1 correspondence table).

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous (symbolic τ, τ̇); residual-free-parameter COUNT is an integer (0,1,2,...) — the PASS predicate is on count==1"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "N/A — symbolic closed-form completeness test"
  L_max: "N/A — closed-form a₂(τ); no spectral-cache truncation"
  scan_range: "N/A — symbolic τ"
  step_size: "N/A — symbolic"
  tolerance: "exact (symbolic); residual_free_normalization_count is an exact integer"
  scheme: "IKKT-matrix-model-genre (a₂ eigenvalue-functional; f₂≈92 dictionary)"
  convention: "EMERGENT-H-READOUT (H is spectral-reorganization readout; NOT container clock)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic symbolic"
  GPU_path: "N/A — Sage-MCP symbolic"

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The a₂(τ) monotone gradient, via the Chamseddine–Connes dictionary,
            yields a closed H²=F(τ,τ̇) with exactly one residual free
            normalization (the M_KK⁻¹→seconds factor)."

    Step 1 (definitions):
      ρ_eff(τ,τ̇)  ≡ ½ G_DeWitt τ̇² + V_a₂(τ).                                 [modulus kinetic + a₂ potential; G_DeWitt=5.0, S42]
      G_eff(τ)     ≡ [16π · f₂ Λ² a₂(τ)/(48π²)]^{−1},  f₂≈92, Λ=M_KK.          [§8.3 dictionary]
      H²(τ,τ̇)     ≡ (8π G_eff(τ)/3) ρ_eff(τ,τ̇).                              [emergent Friedmann FORM — equation of state, not fundamental]
    Step 2 (substitute):
      H²(τ,τ̇) = (8π/3)·[16π f₂ Λ² a₂(τ)/(48π²)]^{−1}·[½ G_DeWitt τ̇² + V_a₂(τ)].
    Step 3 (identify residual free normalization):
      τ̇ carries units of (substrate-time)⁻¹; H carries units of (emergent-time)⁻¹.
      The map (substrate-time → emergent seconds) is the UNCLOSED normalization
      Z_norm (§8.3 Z_fold PRELIMINARY). Every OTHER symbol (a₂(τ), G_DeWitt, f₂,

    Step 4 (count and read off):
      residual_free_normalization_count = number of unpinned scalars in H²(τ,τ̇)
      after substituting all canonical pins.
      PASS  ⇔ count == 1 (Z_norm only) AND H²(τ,τ̇) is a closed symbolic function.
      INFO  ⇔ H²(τ,τ̇) closes but count > 1 (a second normalization, e.g. V_a₂
              offset, also unpinned — the form is exhibited but more conditional).
      FAIL  ⇔ no closed H²(τ,τ̇) form is obtainable (the genre framing fails to
              produce even a conditional expansion-rate form).
    Step 5 (genre cross-check, direction-bearing):
      dS/dτ = +58672.8 > 0 (dS_fold) ⇒ monotone weight e^{−S} ⇒ NO interior
      saddle ⇒ NO self-dual τ ⇒ NO T-duality ⇒ matrix-model-class (computable
      emergent background), NOT SFT-class. This confirms the extraction is of the
      COMPUTABLE genre even where the second normalization remains open.
    Conclusion: the verdict is the residual-free-normalization count; a count of 1
    confirms the gap is a SINGLE missing normalization (matrix-model background
    extraction), the strongest honest reading of §6.3.

    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
```

```yaml
    that the single-crystal loop lacked? Report the fixed-point structure

    ρ_relic (produced quanta) → a₂-channel feedback → emergent H²; the produced

substitution_chain:

    Claim: "The feedback functional H²=f(ρ_relic,S_SA) is well-posed (definite
            sign, bounded fixed point) when the FABRIC restoring term is included,
            even though the S19d single-crystal self-consistency loop diverges."

    Step 1 (definitions):
      ρ_relic    ≡ Σ_bands m_b · n_{k,b} · Δ_b,  m_b∈{2,4,8,6}, Δ_b∈{Δ_B1,Δ_B2,Δ_B3,...}.   [produced-quanta density; n_pairs=59.8 total, S38]
      S_SA(τ)    ≡ a₀(τ) − a₂(τ) + a₄(τ),  monotone, dS/dτ=+58672.8>0.                         [spectral action gradient; dS_fold, S42]
      H²(τ)      ≡ f(ρ_relic, S_SA(τ)) = (8πG_eff(τ)/3)·ρ_relic + (back-reaction of dS/dτ).    [feedback functional — the OWED equation of state]
    Step 2 (substitute the single-crystal loop, recover the CLOSED divergence):
      Single-crystal iterative map (S19d): ε_k^{sc} = ε_k^bare − ½α_G(a₂^sc)(ε_k^sc)²(1+C₂/3).
      This map has NO finite fixed point (CLOSED, S40 — diverges; Weinberg no-go,
      Goldstone sector). So f WITHOUT the fabric term inherits this divergence.
    Step 3 (add the FABRIC restoring term, TAU-STAB):
      f_fabric(ρ_relic,S_SA) = f_single-crystal + R_neighbor(τ),
      where R_neighbor(τ) is the neighboring-crystal resistance to τ-change (S41,
      TAU-STAB open channel). R_neighbor > 0 opposes the runaway.
    Step 4 (direction read-off — sign of the net feedback):
      dS/dτ = +58672.8 > 0 drives τ forward (no interior minimum, single crystal).
      R_neighbor(τ) > 0 opposes. The net sign of d(H²)/dτ near the candidate
      fixed point determines closure:
        if R_neighbor dominates near some τ* ⇒ d(H²)/dτ changes sign ⇒ finite
           fixed point H²* ⇒ wellposed_flag True ⇒ PASS.
        if R_neighbor never dominates ⇒ monotone runaway ⇒ inherits S19d
           divergence ⇒ FAIL.
        if the dominance is parametrically marginal / fabric-stiffness-dependent
           ⇒ INFO (well-posed in form, fixed point conditional).
    Step 5 (well-posedness vs convergence — the key distinction):
      The gate tests WELL-POSEDNESS of f (definite sign + bounded fixed point),
      NOT whether the divergent S19d loop "converges" (it provably does not). A
      PASS means the gauge-invariant FABRIC feedback is a well-defined equation of
      state; it does NOT reopen the CLOSED single-crystal divergence.
    Conclusion: the verdict is the fixed-point structure of f_fabric; the produced
    quanta ARE the substrate reorganization (PHONONIC), the feedback IS the owed
    equation of state, and the divergent single-crystal loop stays closed.
```

## Wave 3 → Wave 4 Decision Point

Wave 4 (white-hole kinematic consistency / analog-temperature ledger / conformal embedding) does **not** consume Wave 3 outputs as gating inputs — the two waves are independent. The cross-wave coherence checks (run at session-end synthesis, not as a dispatch dependency):

- **HAW-V4 (§W3-4) ↔ W4 HAW-V1 (analog-T ledger)**: both touch de Sitter / Gibbons–Hawking horizon thermodynamics. If §W3-4 returns INFO-form-matches (ρ_vac is the dS horizon-energy form), it corroborates HAW-V1's surface-gravity `T_a=ħκ/2π` ledger treatment. No conflict expected; flag if §W3-4 FAILs the form-match (would question the horizon-thermodynamic reading W4 also uses).
- **Internal Wave-3 coherence (the multi-axis object)**: §W3-1 (EMERGENT-EIH-LIFT), §W3-2 (EFF-FRIEDMANN-GENRE), and §W3-3 (BACK-REACTION-CLOSURE) attack the SAME a(t) bridge. Their verdicts MUST be mutually consistent: if §W3-1 FAILs/INFOs on a residual normalization, §W3-2 should report the SAME residual-free-normalization count==1 (or name the same extra normalization), and §W3-3 should report the feedback well-posed-but-conditional on the same fabric-stiffness normalization. A divergence among the three (e.g. §W3-1 PASS but §W3-2 FAIL) is a cross-gate tension to surface at synthesis as a candidate workshop (per `Investigating-Workshops.md` Q1 — a genuine math/physics adjudication on which axis read the bridge correctly).
- **§W3-5 (EMERGENT-EP-NLO) → §W3-1 corroboration**: a §W3-5 PASS (EP derived at NLO) corroborates the EP component that the §W3-1 EIH lift must reproduce; a §W3-5 FAIL (EP-violation) would predict a non-conservative residual in §W3-1 (the two should be consistent — an EP-violating substrate cannot have a fully-conservative emergent G_eff^{μν}).

**Branching**:
- If §W3-1 PASS (a(t) skeleton closes): the framework's single most load-bearing open dimension closes; queue the §6.3 doc-integration `/rclab-workshop` to land the derived a(t) (per integration-plan §F sequencing) and re-tag capstone frontiers #1 AND #8.
- If §W3-1/§W3-2/§W3-3 all INFO (the expected outcome): the gap is sharpened to a single named normalization (Z_fold/seconds + fabric-stiffness); carry forward ONE consolidated 4-field CF "pin the emergent-time normalization Z_norm + fabric-stiffness" to S96, NOT three separate ones.
- If §W3-5 FAIL (EP-violation): land a new falsifier-inventory row (mack-cosmic-bridge sole writer) for the computable band-dependent EP-violation; this is a genuine new prediction, not a defeat.
